title: Waiver template
description: Every diver signs this one release.

banner.invalid: That didn't save. The release needs to be at least a few sentences long.
banner.unchanged: No change — the release is exactly as it was, so nothing was published and no signature was affected.
banner.resigning: {count, plural, one {New version published. # signed release no longer counts — that diver signs again before boarding.} other {New version published. # signed releases no longer count — those divers sign again before boarding.}}

confirm.message: {count, plural, one {Publishing this replaces the release that # diver has signed. They sign again before boarding.} other {Publishing this replaces the release that # divers have signed. They all sign again before boarding.}}

placeholder: Write the release the diver will read and sign.

releaseDescription.current: Saving replaces this for new links; already-signed waivers keep the text they were signed against.
releaseDescription.sample: This is sample wording to start from — edit it to fit your shop, and have your own counsel review it.
